title: Reading the Neighborhood: Text-Attentive Graph Reranking for Automated Subject Indexing
abstract: arXiv:2610.20048v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Subject indexing assigns descriptors from a controlled vocabulary to bibliographic records, a task characterized by thousands of labels, few positive examples per label, and a long tail of rarely used descriptors. Existing extreme multi-label classifiers treat the vocabulary as a flat list, ignoring the semantic relations that thesauri encode. We present TAGHN, a heterogeneous graph reranker over a per-document subgraph of retrieved candidates augmented with the thesaurus neighborhood. The relevance of a candidate descriptor is estimated jointly from its similarity with the document and also the degree to which the candidate's thesaurus neighborhood matches the document content. A decomposed scoring head combines interpretable graph-derived features with retrieval signals. On STW, an economic thesaurus of 6,198 descriptors, TAGHN reaches 0.380 macro F1 against 0.346 for a fine-tuned cross-encoder and 0.278 for a fixed-vocabulary XMLC cla

translated_title: 阅读邻域：面向自动主题标引的文本注意力图重排序
translated_abstract: 主题标引是将受控词表中的描述词分配给书目记录的任务，其特点是标签数量达数千个、每个标签的正样本稀少，以及大量极少使用的描述词构成长尾分布。现有的极端多标签分类器将词表视为扁平列表，忽略了叙词表所编码的语义关系。我们提出了TAGHN，一种异构图重排序器，它在由检索候选词构成的每文档子图上运行，并用叙词表邻域进行增强。候选描述词的相关性是通过其与文档的相似度，以及候选词的叙词表邻域与文档内容的匹配程度共同估计的。一个分解的评分头将可解释的图派生特征与检索信号相结合。在包含6,198个描述词的经济学叙词表STW上，TAGHN达到0.380的宏F1，相比之下微调的交叉编码器为0.346，固定词表的极端多标签分类器为0.278。
tldr: 该论文提出TAGHN，一种利用叙词表邻域语义关系的异构图重排序方法进行自动主题标引，在STW经济叙词表上宏F1达到0.380，超越了微调交叉编码器和固定词表极端多标签分类器。
en_tdlr: TAGHN, a heterogeneous graph reranker that leverages thesaurus neighborhood semantics for automated subject indexing, achieves 0.380 macro F1 on the STW economic thesaurus, outperforming fine-tuned cross-encoders and fixed-vocabulary XMLC classifiers.
